codex.diaithir_overworld_biomes.bog.body: A waterlogged lowland of mangrove-like trees and orchids. Slimes and frogs thrive here.
codex.diaithir_overworld_biomes.lavender: Open fields dense with alliums, favoured by bees and rabbits.
codex.diaithir_overworld_biomes.redwood_: Towering giant conifers over a podzol floor. Wolves roam the shade.
codex.diaithir_overworld_biomes.volcanic: Ash-fallen basalt flats with magma cubes. Ambient temperature near 1.4 on the climate scale.
codex.diaithir_overworld_biomes.blooming: Flower-rich meadows, groves and wetlands spread across the overworld, regrown on new chunks only.
codex.diaithir_overworld_biomes.flora.bo: Ferns, shrubs, mushrooms, tall grasses and mixed flower beds that fill the blooming biomes.
Boulders, clay, gravel, moss and podzol patches that break up flat ground in blooming biomes.
codex.diaithir_overworld_biomes.biome_co: Points toward the nearest biome you choose. Right-click to search; the needle settles on the closest match.
codex.diaithir_overworld_biomes.thornwak: A wood grown in the wake of something that did not stop growing. Thorn and berry choke the ground, and old stones stand under the briars where an Ascendant rite was once kept. Tier I rites wake here.
codex.diaithir_overworld_biomes.cinderfe: A wetland that burns without flame: black water, soul-soil, and magma under the mud. Slagiron is smelted from what the fen gives up. Tier II rites wake here.
Ground where the Ages' clock has run down: pale, still, and wrong underfoot. Few trees, no weather. The last rites wake here, and The Last Wheel with them. Tier III rites wake here.
